correctness.rationale: The open-neighborhood definition excludes the common center. Every pair of rook cells admits a common distinct neighbor for m,n>=3; hence the one-skeleton is complete and the triangle-boundary matrix on the cycle basis gives integral H1. The package supplies three explicit integer minor witnesses of orders 26,54,105 with determinants -1,+1,+2, proving the upper invariant-factor bounds. Row/column integer cocycles give independent free-rank lower bounds at (3,3), and the row cocycle gives a nonzero infinite pairing at (3,4). The crossing-edge mod-2 cocycle pairs nontrivially with a corner three-cycle at (4,4). Connected-link vertex attachments, with links computed in the *full graph* induced subcomplex and old two-skeleton unchanged, propagate quotient bounds and cocycle lower bounds to every m,n>=4 and m=3,n>=4. Independently regenerated triangle matrices have GF2/GF3/GF101 ranks: (3,3)26/26/26 of 28, (3,4)54/54/54 of 55, (4,4)104/105/105 of 105 and (4,5)170/171/171 of 171; finite link graphs connected for (3,5),(4,5),(5,4),(5,5),(6,7). These finite checks do not establish integral Smith invariants or all-size link assertions on their own; proof uses exact certificate minors and general connected-link argument.

value.rationale: An exact natural H1 invariant of the Lovasz neighborhood complex for the entire rectangular rook family resolves a genuine 3-row/free versus >=4/torsion boundary, stronger than a single finite census. The nonvanishing persistent 2-torsion constrains wedge-of-spheres/homotopy modeling, and the induction mechanism via links can be reused for similar graph families. This is motivated topology, not isolated arithmetic.

limitations: Only m,n>=3, open neighborhood H1; no full fundamental group/higher homology classification.
Independent bounded modular rank/link checks are corroboration, not proof of all-size integral SNF; exact supplied witnesses and proof carry the result.
